context: Coordinated with PC session; GPU lock absent and 0% utilization before setup; sequential fresh SSH/Python deployments; shared worker lock respected. Mac standalone safe Metal gates for cooling fixtures, archived production Metal dataset gate for flat district. No training or full batch generation.
scope:
Profile complete SSH deployments with a primed optional PTX cache and unchanged gates.

Plan JSON is a list of {name, input, reference, retrieval: all|dataset}. Every job runs
three alternating uncached/cached pairs. No accepted datasets are published. Outputs
must be new; partial reports remain explicitly incomplete after failure/interruption.

result.timingScope: Host wall time; compile includes device capability query; setup includes module load, upload and initial kernels; output includes final validation and array writes; excludes manifest writes and module unload

Byte counts are file sizes, not compressed wire bytes.
